**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (no redline).**

The agreement has no renewal architecture whatsoever. I checked both planner candidates (p0363, p0252), read Article VIII (Termination) in full, and ran independent searches for "renew", "automatically renew", "successive … unless notice", "extension/expire/expiration", "term of this Agreement" and servicing-fee escalation language — nothing responsive on renewal terms, non-renewal notice windows or price uplift.

- **Term structure:** Section 8.3 (p0363) is self-liquidating — the Agreement terminates on the earlier of the last Receivable being paid in full/settled/sold/written off or termination of the Issuer under the Trust Agreement. Articles VIII's other provisions are Optional Acquisition/Clean-Up Redemption and Optional Redemption mechanics, not renewals.
- **Conditional elements:** Because renewal is not automatic and no price increase right exists, both fallback elements (≤60-day non-renewal window; ≤5% uplift) and the conditional preferred elements (12-month term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder, CPI/3% cap) are satisfied vacuously.
- **Mutual written agreement:** Any extension of the term could only come through an amendment by the parties under Article X (p0392), which aligns with the preferred "mutual written agreement" position.

No exposure to a renewal trap or uncapped uplift, so the rule is structurally inapplicable here and drafting a renewal-and-uplift construct into a securitization TSA would be inapposite.
